email.subject: Quick fix for Summit Pros' site
email.body:
Dev,

Looked at the Summit Pros site. Two things are likely costing you calls: there's no click-to-call number, so mobile visitors have to copy/paste or retype your number instead of tapping to dial. And hours aren't listed anywhere, so someone checking if you're open now just leaves and calls the next HVAC company.

The page is also image-heavy, which slows load time on mobile, and the title tag is generic rather than "HVAC Harbor Falls," which hurts how you show up in search.

I fix these for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's broken, no obligation.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
